t: The Flomasta Round Bottle Trap in white, 32mm, is a compact plumbing solution designed to prevent unpleasant odours from entering properties. Its shallow, space-saving design makes it ideal for installations in confined areas such as under basins in cloakrooms or small bathrooms. Constructed from durable polypropylene, rubber, and TPE, this bottle trap offers abrasion and corrosion resistance, ensuring longevity and reliability. It features a 50mm water seal and a 32mm compression horizontal outlet, suitable for plastic pipes and providing an efficient flow rate of 41.4Ltr/min. The unit is demountable and reusable for convenient maintenance.
b: Space-Saving Shallow Design for Tight Installations
Suitable for Plastic Pipes & Basin Applications
